movement: A.1(a),(b) now have complete counterexamples in every characteristic: a fully specified very ample threefold has strictly more crystalline H2 p-torsion on every smooth degree-one section, so torsion restriction is not surjective and the cokernel is not torsion-free. The separate coherent surface question is also refuted in every prime, with an exact characteristic-two coherent degree list. The former unrestricted integral yes/no gate has therefore shrunk to A.1(c), together with the still-required exact intermediate integral degrees. The complete proofs have root and reduction-descent independent audits.

A.4 on the fixed ordinary product surface now includes full degree-three image GL80(F2), transvection generation in every degree, and the exact invariant covector dimension in all parities. At review02 only full degrees1 and2 and parity-restricted uniform covectors were established. The fixed-surface full-image gate now starts at degree4; uniform irreducibility and the group on the common kernel remain unresolved.

The remaining B.3 elliptic existence problem is now equivalent, for every fixed p,e,n, to an explicitly bounded finite polynomial formula over Fpbar; if affirmative it has a finite-local-field realization. This replaces the unbounded field-and-lift search by a finite algebraic decision problem. The formula at full27,e216 is not evaluated, and no numerical existence verdict is counted as proved. Higher-dimensional sharp thresholds remain unchanged.
unresolved_refinements: The simultaneous locally Noetherian-base and coherent-coefficient insertion recorded in manuscript6:7 remains undecided beyond the established positive comparison cases. The broad E.2 prompt assertion is refuted.

The new proposed A.1(c) threefold construction and the proposed reduction of uniform product full groups to geometric Hasse-divisor irreducibility are still under proof and independent audit. Neither candidate is counted in this review.
